Subject: Six-Week Pilot Proposal

Dear Morgan,

I propose a six-week pilot to assess invoice handling for a $30,000 fixed fee. Production rollout is excluded.

The client hopes for 20% shorter handling time. No baseline or measured savings exists.

Security approval is required before access to client data. No start date has been approved.

Please approve the pilot scope and fee, subject to security clearance.

Best regards,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
